verdict.rationale: Phoenix is free to self-host with no feature limitations, and its docs say data stays entirely within your infrastructure, nothing is sent to Arize, and it can be fully air-gapped. Deployment options include Docker, Kubernetes/Helm, AWS CloudFormation, Google Cloud Run, Azure ARM and others, so you control residency by choosing where to deploy. Missing for 10: any documented region or residency selection for a managed/hosted Phoenix offering, explicit residency or compliance documentation, and independent corroboration of the self-hosted data-locality claims.
